services.name: Youth Fishing
services.desc: Believe it or not we do have a Tarpon fishery here in South Carolina! These big powerful fish migrate into our waters in mid summer, typically arriving in June and leaving in October. Definitely my favorite fish to pursue here in South Carolina. I have caught tarpon here anywhere from 30 to 180 pounds, with most fish being in the 100 or 100 + pound range. In my opinion there is nothing more exciting than being hooked up to a beautiful South Carolina Silver King. Most always these fish come completely airborne multiple times during the fight.
